show.description: Revanth, the illegitimate son of a powerful minister, is framed for his father’s murder by his stepmother Pushpa. After marrying Sitara in a twisted setup, he finds love and redemption through her sincerity. As he secretly builds an empire and seeks vengeance, Revanth exposes Pushpa’s crimes, reclaims his honor, and begins a new life with Sitara.
